description: Given an IPv4 CIDR block (e.g. 10.0.0.0/22), return its network and broadcast addresses, subnet and wildcard masks, usable host range and host count, and whether it is private (RFC 1918). Optionally split it into equal smaller subnets. IPv4 only.

cidr.description: IPv4 address with prefix length, e.g. 192.168.1.0/24.

split_prefix.description: If set, divide the block into subnets of this prefix length (must be longer than the block's own).

name: cidr_calculate
title: Calculate an IPv4 subnet
